policy.candidate_seed: emitted keyword event OR p(class1)>=0.5 OR p(class2)>=0.5
policy.event_clock: input availability sample count; not acoustic word end
policy.merge: strictly overlapping half-open source PCM windows; merge across keywords without duplicating PCM
policy.no_candidate_means: empty review queue, not a proven negative or FAR result
policy.priority: has_event descending; maximum_keyword_probability descending; recording_id/start/end ascending
policy.state_policy: reset only between original utterances; no concatenation or gap filling
